docs/batchline-api.md.text:
# Batchline API 2.3 — stored contract excerpt
Owner: Batchline API team. Published and applicable to this fixture's captured API revision.
This synthetic exercise contract is independent of the proposed client patch.
`GET /runs/{run_id}/attempts/{attempt}/jobs` returns `run_id` as string, `attempt` as positive integer, and `jobs` as a nonempty array. Each job has a nonempty `steps` array.
Each step has `status` in `queued`, `running`, `pending`, `completed`.
`queued`, `running`, and `pending` are unfinished states with `conclusion: null`; `pending` can remain while another step executes. Completed steps have `success`, `skipped`, `failure`, or `cancelled` conclusion.
A capture describes platform behavior; application policy is owned by the client project.

docs/execution-policy.md.text:
# Execution policy EP-17, revision 4
Owner: Release Engineering. Approved 2026-10-18. Applies to src/admission.mjs and src/runner.mjs; supersedes revision 3.
R-1 (must): Accept only the exact expected run ID and attempt. Reject malformed/empty inventory and unknown step states.
R-2 (must): Invoke the phase command exactly once when all steps of the exact inventory are either successful/skipped completed steps or unfinished steps recognized by the applicable provider contract with null conclusion.
R-3 (must): Invoke no command when any step has failed/cancelled, a completed step lacks a terminal conclusion, or an unfinished step has a nonnull conclusion.
The reviewed enforcement boundary is the local admission function and its runPhase command dispatch. Transport acquisition and the command's own business behavior are outside this patch and acceptance boundary.
